key_idea: Write the expected time of each of the three strategies as a linear function of p and compare; a failed submit costs 0.3 plus a full retype n+1 keystrokes.
sketch: Continue costs (n-k+1)*0.1 and fails with probability p; backspace costs (n-k+2)*0.1 and fails with probability 1-p (it deleted a correct character); a failure adds 0.3+(n+1)*0.1. Restart costs 0.3+(n+1)*0.1 deterministically. Scale everything by 1000 and compare in integers to avoid floating error: 100(n-k+1)+p(n+4), 100(n-k+2)+(100-p)(n+4), 100(n+4). O(1). Pitfall is only the modelling of what backspace does when no slip happened; the samples pin it down.
